cohort: The study included fetuses with fetal growth restriction (FGR) and a control group of appropriately grown fetuses matched at the time of ultrasonography.
finding: Fetuses with fetal growth restriction (FGR) showed reduced frontal lobe growth compared to appropriately grown fetuses, and fetal frontal lobe development disorders were not significantly different in FGR fetuses with or without fetal circulatory redistribution (FCR).
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, between August 2020 and April 2021
gest_age: Fetuses of varying gestational ages, matched for gestational age between groups and standardized for analysis.
